primary_task: Extract selected metadata and flag standard-tag PHI from one DICOM file by running scripts/extract_metadata.py (pydicom) and emitting JSON.

requirements.name: Bash
requirements.evidence: allowed-tools: Bash; run the Bash/Python command shown below

requirements.name: pydicom
requirements.evidence: Reads one DICOM file with pydicom
requirements.check: python3 -c "import importlib.util; print(importlib.util.find_spec('pydicom') is not None)"; pip download --no-deps -q -d $(mktemp -d) pydicom

requirements.name: medagent / eval_engine (trusted-run verification)
requirements.evidence: run medagent.verifiers.dicom_metadata_quality_v1 on evidence packs before treating the run as reviewed evidence

notes: Verifier/trusted-run steps are second-pass review, not core extraction; they are repo-internal modules supplied with the user's repo.
